summary: Iteration 9 — full test of the new 'News & Märkte' feature. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_news_markte.py (19 pytest cases) covering feed structure/counts/filters/sorting, market insights, public editorial and full admin editorial CRUD + authz (401/403/404/400/422). 19/19 pass. Full suite 62/63 (only the pre-existing ingress CORS override test fails). Frontend: /news renders all 7 sections correctly (hero 1+2 cards, 12-row ticker with working category filters, 7 market tiles, 9 weitere rows, 6 anleger cards, editorial post from DB, philosophy CTA with both CTAs navigating). Nav label 'News & Märkte' present. CRITICAL: the /admin/editorial admin UI is completely unreachable — the app's route guard (ProtectedRoute) uses the legacy Supabase AuthContext while the new editorial endpoints use FastAPI httpOnly-cookie auth; admin@kapitalmitte.com/admin123 does not exist in Supabase (Supabase /auth/v1/token returns 400) so /admin/editorial redirects to /login?next=/admin/editorial. Proven with a browser-side FastAPI login (200) + GET /api/news-markte/editorial/admin (200) while the UI route still bounced.

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: /admin/editorial cannot be opened at all. ProtectedRoute/AuthContext authenticate against Supabase, but the editorial API uses FastAPI cookie auth; the FastAPI admin account does not exist in Supabase (Supabase login 400) so the route redirects to /login. Even with a valid FastAPI cookie present in the browser (verified: adminList returns 200 via fetch) the UI guard still bounces. Admin create/edit/publish-toggle/delete flows are therefore untestable and unusable in the product.

critical_code_review_comments: Two parallel auth systems: new FastAPI cookie auth (news-markte editorial) behind a Supabase-based ProtectedRoute — architectural inconsistency that makes the admin feature unusable. Pick one session source of truth.
news_markte_feed computes 'top' from all articles even when a category filter is applied; also does a second full collection read per filtered request (extra query per call).
delete_editorial does not raise 404 when deleted_count == 0 — silent no-op success.
AdminEditorial delete uses window.confirm (blocking native dialog) instead of the app's dialog component.
Market fallback values are hardcoded constants inside server.py; consider a config/seed file and marking the response with a 'source: fallback' flag so the UI can label it honestly.

rca_of_the_issue: Admin editorial UI unreachable: /app/frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.js reads user from @/context/AuthContext, which is backed by supabase.auth (supabase.auth.signInWithPassword). The new editorial endpoints in /app/backend/server.py use require_admin against the FastAPI httpOnly access_token cookie, and newsMarkteApi.js sends withCredentials to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api. Logging in through the UI with the documented FastAPI admin credentials fails at Supabase (POST https://<project>.supabase.co/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password -> 400), so ProtectedRoute has no user and redirects to /login?next=%2Fadmin%2Feditorial. Reproduction: (1) open /login, submit admin@kapitalmitte.com/admin123 -> stays on /login, Supabase 400; (2) in-page fetch('/api/auth/login') -> 200 and fetch('/api/news-markte/editorial/admin') -> 200; (3) navigate to /admin/editorial -> still redirected to /login. Mitigation: guard admin routes with the FastAPI session (GET /api/auth/me) or bridge Supabase sessions to FastAPI.
